items.title: John Handy Interview, 1958-12-15
items.q: I haven't seen him now in about eight, nine months.

ctx.x: Never heard him. You never heard him play? Never found him. Huh? He always plays with somebody where I'm not there, it seems like. You know? It's funny.

And he's a very quiet guy. He don't say nothing to nobody. He said that. And I bet he'd sit up there and play all night and wouldn't say three words. Never say nothing. Unless you ask him something. You ask him something. He'd give you that flat answer then. That's all. No more talk. He's a peculiar guy. He won't talk. He talk too much when he get to drinking. But there is only me drinking. He don't drink that much. At least he didn't used to drink. I haven't seen him now in about eight, nine months. He's a great…
And then what happened? You came back here from St. Louis? Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah.
